# SkillMall — Skill Catalog

Agent-readable index of all skills in this repository.
Deploy a skill by copying its directory to `~/.claude/skills/<category>/<slug>/`.

## How to Use a Skill

Invoke in Claude Code by name, or copy to your local skills directory:

```bash
# Copy a skill to Claude Code
cp -r skills/<category>/<skill-name> ~/.claude/skills/

# Scaffold a new skill
bash scripts/new-skill.sh <category> <skill-name>
```
